name: Munnar Ramesh
bio: Munnar Ramesh is an Indian actor who works in Tamil-language films. He is known for his character and villain roles.

credits.title: Con City
credits.overview: Saravana, Mithra, Jacky, and Janaki, are skilled con artists hiding out as an ordinary family in Mulki, Karnataka. Their quiet life shatters when a young boy in their care is kidnapped, forcing them to use their old hustles one last time.

credits.title: Sannidhanam P.O.
credits.overview: A mother's search for her son who went missing when he was a child.

credits.title: Karuppu
credits.overview: In a world where justice falters, guardian deity Vettai Karuppu takes the guise of a lawyer to battle a corrupt legal system preying on the powerless.

credits.title: Sirai
credits.overview: As he transfers a young convict from prison to court, a police officer learns about the chain of events that led to the young man's conviction for violence.

credits.title: Mask
credits.overview: 440 crores stolen. Seven days to get it back. A game of greed, betrayal and intrigue culminates in an explosive climax in this story of a greedy man, a conniving woman and an uncanny guy with a bag full of tricks.

credits.title: Diesel
credits.overview: During the 1980s, Manoharan was a leader in the city's crude oil smuggling business. Manohar opposed Patanis dream of setting up a private port that would become a hub for the black market oil trade. credits.title: Right
credits.overview: A desperate father searching for his missing son finds himself trapped inside a police station when a mysterious entity seals the station building, forcing those within to confront their secrets as a deadly game.

credits.title: Phoenix
credits.overview: A teenage boxer accused of a high-profile political murder is quietly sent to a juvenile reformatory, where relentless assassination attempts test his survival. As he battles for his life and identity behind bars, he must summon inner strength to confront a dangerous past and hostile enemies.

credits.title: Viduthalai: Part II
credits.overview: Troubles worsen for Kumaresan after the capture of Perumal, and soon he is confronted with having to make a choice between performing his duties as a police constable, or taking a stand for what is right.

credits.title: Theerkadarishi
credits.overview: A stranger keeps calling the police control room to hint about various crimes and accidents that are about to occur in the near future. Can the police department stop an accident based on his information and also find out who their mysterious informer actually is?

credits.title: Viduthalai: Part I
credits.overview: Kumaresan, a police constable, gets recruited for an operation implanted to capture Perumal Vaathiyar, who leads a separatist group dedicated to fighting against the authorities for committing atrocities against innocent village women in the name of police interrogations.

credits.title: Run Baby Run
credits.overview: A bank employee encounters a stranger girl inside his car on his way home from work. Little did he know the girl's presence would put his life in trouble.

credits.title: Vallavanukkum Vallavan
credits.overview: Two conmen, who believe that money can solve all their problems, decide to extract money from wrongdoers. Trouble begins when a mad policeman crosses their way.

credits.title: Payanigal Gavanikkavum
credits.overview: After spending two sleepless nights taking care of his sick daughter, Ezhilan, a person with hearing and speech disability falls asleep in a metro. A Social Media Addict captures this moment and uploads it on social media with a caption saying 'Drunkard On A Public Transport'.

credits.title: Kombu Vatcha Singamda
credits.overview: Six friends, who follow Periyaar's ideologies, fall prey to the local caste politics that happens in their hometown. Who is the reason behind this and what happens after?

credits.title: Carbon
credits.overview: A man whose dreams come true tries to discover the identity of the hit-and-driver who has put his father in critical condition.

credits.title: Naanga Romba Busy
credits.overview: An honest policeman, a con man, and a hopeless romantic form an unusual team during the days of demonetization to pull off a scam that quickly goes haywire.

credits.title: Naan Sirithal
credits.overview: A man suffers from a condition where he laughs uncontrollably under stressful conditions and it causes a lot of trouble for him until he seeks a strong solution for it.

credits.title: Adavi
credits.overview: A tribe in a mountain tries to save their land from a greedy estate owner.

credits.title: Irandam Ulagaporin Kadaisi Gundu
credits.overview: A hardworking lorry driver who works at an old paper mart learns about the presence of a bomb and does everything he can to stop it from exploding.

credits.title: Asuran
credits.overview: A family from the underprivileged class is on the run after the teenaged son kills a rich man from the upper caste. Can the pacifist father be able to save his hot-blooded son?

credits.title: Nungambakkam
credits.overview: The story based on the sensational Swathi murder case. Nungambakkam title refers to the railway station in Chennai where the 24-year-old software engineer Swathi was stabbed to death. Swathi was murdered when she was waiting for the train in the morning at the Nungambakkam railway station on June 24, 2016.

credits.title: Igloo
credits.overview: Webbed around a couple who believe, preach and practise positivity, where the ‘picture perfect’ lives of a couple are devastated with a hazardous illness and how they handle it positively

credits.title: Vada Chennai
credits.overview: Anbu, a young carrom player in North Chennai becomes inadvertently involved in an ongoing conflict between two local gangsters.

credits.title: Annanukku Jey
credits.overview: The son of a toddy seller decides to become a politician to take on bar owner who tries to bring down his father.

credits.title: Kaatu Paya Sir Intha Kaali
credits.overview: A cop prone to violence is tasked with capturing a psycho who has been setting vehicles belonging to employees of a financier on fire.

credits.title: Ulkuthu
credits.overview: A stranger comes to a coastal village and gets into a tiff with the local gangster and his son.

credits.title: Enakku Veru Engum Kilaigal Kidayathu
credits.overview: On a pleasure trip, Krishnan, who rents out caravan for film shoots, saves a couple on the run and takes it on himself to get them married.

credits.title: Visaranai
credits.overview: Pandi and his friends, immigrant workers in Andhra Pradesh, are picked up by cops for a crime they never committed. And thus begins their nightmare, where they become pawns in a vicious game where the voiceless are strangled by those with power.

credits.title: 49-O
credits.overview: Karikalan a selfish politician, in collusion with a real estate agent, usurps the lands of farmers in a village. Savuri decides to expose the politician and get the lands back to the villagers in a novel manner.

credits.title: Vaalu
credits.overview: Sharp (Simbu), a happy-go-lucky guy, loves Priya (Hansika), a college student, but later learns that she is enagaged to Anbu ( Aditya), a businessman-gangster. Priya wants them to remain friends and Sharp agrees, all the while scheming to make her fall in love with him.

credits.title: Budhanin Sirippu
credits.overview: Story of three person challenges the evil practices of country’s corruption, abuse of power and officer lethargic management.

credits.title: India Pakistan
credits.overview: It is only after moving in to their shared office space do Karthick and Mellina realize that they are in the same profession — law. So, they decide that whoever gets a case first will stay in the place and fight tooth-and-nail to get a case. Meanwhile, a cop, who is searching for a DVD containing video of his illegal e

credits.title: Jigarthanda
credits.overview: A budding director endeavors to research a merciless gangster for making a film on gangsterism. But his secret attempts to conduct the research fail when he gets caught for snooping.

credits.title: His Wife
credits.overview: Gracie, a young Tamil woman living near Madras, has been having behavioural disorders since the day she was married. The memory of her French friend Catherine, who died in unresolved circumstances, seems to be haunting her. Catherine's grieving ex-husband, Joseph, decides to go to India to meet Gracie and possibly, dur

credits.title: Nimirndhu Nil
credits.overview: Aravind, a principled young man, takes on the corrupt officers in the government. They soon launch a counter-attack. Will Aravind emerge victorious or succumb to their wiles?

credits.title: 6 candles
credits.overview: Ram and Lizzy lead a happy life with their son Gautham. On the boy's sixth birthday, they take him out to the beach where he goes missing. Ram begins a long hunt for his son, which takes him all over the country and drives him to the depths of despair. Will there be redemption in the end?

credits.title: Kumki
credits.overview: The story revolves around a mahout and his trained elephant.

credits.title: Asthamanam
credits.overview: Asthamanam is an adventure trip of four boys and two girls who go into a forest for trekking. What the forest has in store for the young people forms the arc of the film.

credits.title: Velayudham
credits.overview: A journalist identifies an ordinary milk vendor who unwittingly put a stop to a terrorist attack. Inspired by his good deed, she convinces him to become a superhero and a symbol of hope.

credits.title: Aadukalam
credits.overview: Pettaikaaran is famous in his town for an impeccable track record of successes in rooster fights. When one of his aides, Karuppu, goes against his word in a fight, it leads to an enmity between them.

credits.title: Thittakudi
credits.overview: Director Suntharan probably wanted to give some sort of social message with his movie but the way he scripted the screenplay, the movie sounds more like a wannabe sensationalist. If loose morals that make people lose their minds and do pretty awful things do not count for sensationalism, what else will?

credits.title: Vettaikaaran
credits.overview: Police-Ravi is a student aspiring to become a police officer,becomes hunted when he helps his friend out of trouble.The hunted becomes the Hunter to secure his future.

credits.title: Perumal
credits.overview: A petty thief, Perumal, rescues and vows to protect a junior doctor, Alamu, when she red-handedly catches a mafia gang's illegal adulteration of drugs and tries to bring it to light.

credits.title: Pathu Pathu
credits.overview: When Subbu, a film director, is found murdered, the police attempts to find the culprit. However, things take a turn as they dig deeper and begin to unravel the mystery.

credits.title: Nepali
credits.overview: After constant harassment by a police officer, Priya, Karthik's wife, ends her life. Soon, a deeper conspiracy comes into play when Karthik is jailed for the murder of the police officer.

credits.title: Vaitheeswaran
credits.overview: Saravanan, a young boy, is killed by an aspiring politician, Dhanasekaran. When the boy's mother tries to commit suicide, she is stopped by a sage who prophesies that her son will be reincarnated.

credits.title: Pudhupettai
credits.overview: The story of ‘Kokki’ Kumar, a carefree teenager from a Chennai slum who runs away from home in the wake of his mother’s death, gets recruited into a local gang and quickly evolves into the dreaded, psychotic right-hand man of a dirty politician.

credits.title: Thalai Nagaram
credits.overview: After Right, a petty criminal, kills Bhai's son, Bhai's gangsters seek revenge by killing Right's friend Balu. Later, Right decides to lead a normal life, but a corrupt police officer exploits him.
